name: Background Introduction
labels: I’ve always worked across different design disciplines rather than narrowing myself down to one. Over time, that range became more than a set of separate skills. It became a core part of how I approach projects.

name: About me description
labels: Bold brand and web design for science-driven asset management

BSR operates with a modern, scientific approach to asset management, but needed a visual presence capable of communicating that difference in a sector still dominated by conservative conventions. The challenge was to combine the credibility and discipline expected from a Swiss financial company with a more contemporary, distinctive character.  The company also had limited visual material to work with, while its research and investment products required a clearer and more accessible way of presenting complex financial information.
